changes: The external documentation A2A request now requires a logical task key and task revision.
The route re-reads the workboard receipt and refuses missing, stale, non-open, or mismatched tasks before PostgreSQL document search.

The ContextManifestV2 identity optionally binds the task key, task revision, task source reference, task-file digest, and workboard snapshot digest; the external documentation route always supplies this binding.
A pure DocumentationFactV1 binder now validates proposed fact spans against already read-back official chunk UTF-8 bytes and records absolute source byte offsets plus a quote digest.
Legacy ContextManifestV2 callers remain compatible when taskBinding is absent.

verification.fullSvelteCheck: svelte-check-native 1.11.1 passed full tsconfig project with 0 errors and 0 warnings; the earlier Node checker run was stopped after sustained multi-gigabyte memory use

remainingBlockers: The scoped Python DSPy entry point explicitly refuses because an authenticated independent canonical ACE readback transport is not configured; a task-bound manifest alone must not be treated as a generated recommendation.
The fact-span binder is implemented and fixture-tested but is not yet connected to a production extractor response or persisted review/admission flow.
No live task-bound retrieval-to-ACE recommendation or validated receipt was produced in this implementation pass.

DOC-15 also separately requires documentation-specific version/authority filtering in the existing retrieval orchestrator and live filtered same-query fan-out; this route change does not close those acceptance criteria.
